scores.notes: Daniel stands in the Babylonian banquet hall declining trays of royal gifts offered by kneeling servants before the enthroned king. The plaster wall on the left stays free of lettering and all figures are coherent and anatomically sound.

Small yellow glyph-like pseudo-lettering is visible inside the rectangular side panels of both red horse-drawn fire engines in the midground, though the marks are too small and garbled to read as words. Otherwise the burning whitewashed house, rose bushes, crowd, and bandaged Hatherley pointing out the window to Holmes and Watson match the text closely.

The bald prophet walks along the hillside road below walled Bethel while youths emerge from the gate pointing and mocking him. White unpainted paper shows at the top-left sky and bottom-right corner, which is accepted for this item.

Peter steps from the wooden boat onto choppy waves toward Jesus standing on the water with an inviting gesture while the other disciples look on in awe. The watercolor fills the frame cleanly with sound anatomy and no faults.

Alice, dressed in a yellow dress with white pinafore rather than the animated blue dress, looks up timidly at the grinning tabby Cheshire Cat with long claws and many teeth perched on a forest branch. Proportions, animal depiction, and edges are all clean.

Saul drops to his knees on the road approaching Damascus as a bright shaft of golden light breaks from the clouds around him while his traveling companions shield themselves and steady a donkey. No lettering, frame, or anatomical defects appear.

While Hur on the left holds up Moses's raised right arm overlooking the valley battle at sunset, on the right Moses's left arm disappears behind the wooden staff and Aaron grips the staff with both of his own white-sleeved hands instead of holding up Moses's left hand. This contradictory pose breaks the core action described in the verse.

David stands in the brook placing smooth stones into his shepherd's pouch while holding his staff and leather sling in his left hand, facing Goliath and his shield-bearer across the valley. The composition, details, and anatomy are coherent and faithful to the text.
Radiant golden light breaks through dark storm clouds over turbulent primordial waters to illustrate the creation of light. No face, body, or human-shaped figure appears in the light or clouds.

A prominent bearded narrator figure holding a staff and rolled scroll stands in the left foreground even though Revelation 4:6 does not call for John to appear in the scene. The throne remains properly empty with radiance only, and the four creatures stand on the sea of glass (though the red calf lacks wings and eyes).

King Hezekiah oversees active work in the Jerusalem temple courtyard with builders, scaffolding, scribes at a table, and the bronze sea on oxen in the foreground. Scrolls remain free of visible lettering and all figures are coherent.

Bald bearded Elisha walks uphill along the rocky path toward walled Bethel as youths behind him on the left and two ahead on the right point and mock him. All limbs, hands, and figures are cleanly rendered with no lettering or edge faults.

Alice sits thoughtfully in a yellow dress and white pinafore at the outdoor tea table with the dressed March Hare, sleeping Dormouse, and somber Hatter during the lull in their riddle conversation. No hat-tag lettering, adaptation costumes, or anatomical issues appear.

Holmes springs onto the iron bed holding a flaring match in his left hand and lashing with his cane at the speckled snake emerging from the ventilator beside the bell-pull while Watson watches tensely from a chair. Poses, lighting, and period costumes match the passage cleanly.

Jesus calls out with outstretched arm toward the rock-cut cave tomb as Lazarus steps forth wrapped in burial cloths while mourners look on in astonishment. Composition, anatomy, and edges are all clean.

Simon Peter wraps his outer garment around himself as he leaps from the fishing boat into the sea toward Jesus standing beside a smoking fire on the distant shore, while John points and the other disciples haul the full net. All poses and anatomy are coherent and respectful.

Stormy waves break over the fishing boat as disciples bail water with clay jars and brace the mast while Jesus sleeps peacefully on a cushion in the stern. Every figure's hands and actions are clear and coherent.

Job kneels with his staff on an ash heap scattered with potsherds outside a walled city, gazing up at a towering whirlwind descending from dark storm clouds. God is represented purely through the tempest without any human face or figure.

Moses leads the multitude of Israelites and their flocks along dry ground strewn with shells between towering walls of parted seawater on left and right. No unseen subject is drawn and foreground figures and animals are anatomically sound.

Oversized Alice in a yellow dress and white pinafore leans over the overturned jury-box putting the green Lizard in head-downwards with its tail waving while the King and Queen watch sternly from the bench and small animal jurymen scramble amidst slates and pencils. Scale, court-card guests, and animal jurymen follow the text and depiction rules.
Samuel pours oil from a curved horn onto the head of kneeling young David in the middle of his brothers and family outside hillside stone houses. Hands, postures, and setting are clean and accurate.

Daniel stands unharmed inside the circular stone den speaking up toward King Darius at the high opening, accompanied by a luminous winged angel and five calm lions. Anatomy of Daniel, the angel, and the lions is sound throughout.

Jesus stands outside the rock-cut tomb beside the rolled-away round stone calling out as wrapped Lazarus emerges from the dark doorway while Mary, Martha, and bystanders react on the right. The ink-and-watercolor scene fills the frame cleanly with no defects.

The image is an incoherent multi-era collage combining Abraham's camp under starry night on the left, King David playing a harp before Jerusalem in the center, and Mary and Joseph with baby Jesus on the right in one literal crowd. In particular, King David sits on a boulder in the middle at glaringly giant scale—roughly three times taller than the normal-sized adults walking directly beside his sandals.

Elderly white-bearded Adam lies peacefully in death inside a nomadic tent surrounded by grieving family members. The watercolor vignettes into white unpainted paper around all four edges and corners, which is explicitly accepted for this item.

Fiery streaks of sulfur and flame rain down from dark storm clouds onto the burning walled cities of Sodom and Gomorrah while Lot and his daughters walk away in the bottom right and Lot's wife looks back. The scene is vivid, coherent, and free of faults.

Ezekiel stands on a rocky outcrop extending his left arm to prophesy over a wide desert valley littered with dry skulls, ribcages, and bones beneath rays of light breaking through clouds. No divine figure is drawn and all anatomy is clean.

In the Baker Street sitting room, Holmes stands between seated Watson and the towering masked Count Von Kramm, whose astrakhan-trimmed double-breasted coat, flame-lined deep blue cloak with brooch, fur-topped boots, vizard mask, and broad-brimmed hat match the text in detail. No screen-adaptation likenesses, lettering, or anatomical faults appear.

A sweeping symbolic panorama follows a winding road from Abraham beside his tents under pre-dawn stars on the left, past David on the walls of Jerusalem in the center, to Mary, Joseph, and baby Jesus in a Bethlehem stable at sunrise on the right. Perspective, scale, and figures remain coherent throughout to visualize the genealogy named in Matthew 1:1.

Alice in a yellow dress and white pinafore speaks with the disembodied grinning head of the Cheshire Cat floating above the croquet lawn while her pink flamingo rests beside her, a hedgehog scurries by, and flat patterned playing-card soldiers arch on hands and feet. No card indices, lettering, or adaptation costumes appear.

A priest in white linen stands beside the flaming bronze horned altar in the Tabernacle courtyard, holding a sacrificed bird in his left hand while dropping plucked feathers and crop onto the ash pile beside the altar. The depiction avoids lingering gore and shows no forbidden divine figure.

Disciples step out of their small fishing boat onto the shore where Jesus sits beside a glowing fire of coals with fish roasting on it and flatbread laid nearby. All figures, hands, and scene elements match the verse cleanly.

Inside a stone room overlooking a hilltop acropolis, Paul holds up a tarnished bronze hand-mirror showing a dim reflection while speaking face to face with a seated companion. Hands, objects, and blank scrolls on the right table are clean and free of lettering.

Under warm rays of sunlight in a Bethlehem courtyard, Samuel pours oil from a horn onto kneeling young David's head while David's brothers and aged father look on. Every figure's pose, hands, and attire are coherent and accurate.

While the father welcomes his ragged son in the center as servants bring a robe and set down sandals, the side groups perform contradictory ring-handling poses away from the son: on the right a green-clad servant appears to place or press a ring onto a female servant's hand, and on the left a deeply stooped servant holds a tiny white object toward a blankly staring servant.
